prose: Prepare to divide your mind by zero! The Great Whiteboard Brotherhood returns to collaboratively ponder our current philosophical studies. Joining tonight are some of our favorite sages, Slick Dissident, and PK. The central question of our roundtable tonight is this: can we actually know anything about the infinite? Tune in and buckle up for a metaphysical showdown against Zeno of Elea and just about every mathematician that ever reckoned a calculus.
music: Vibe Rant intro theme by VOLO
